# `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors`

Convert eligible block-bodied constructors to expression bodies. IDE0021.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `true` |  |
| `when_on_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; }

    public Widget(int value)
    {
        Value = value;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = false`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = true`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; }

    public Widget(int value) => Value = value;
}
```

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = when_on_single_line`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_constructors = when_on_single_line
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
